# chore(hfp-026): clean up UI leftovers from the air-gapped design

## Task

The UI still has a few things left over from the old local-first, air-gapped design (ADR 0001), plus a broken settings button:

- **Subtitle.** Both pages show "Jobs-to-be-Done Research Assistant" under the title (`ProjectListView.vue:82`, `ResearchDashboard.vue:70`). That's too narrow for the app, so remove it.
- **App name.** The projects list shows "AirGap UX" in its header. The project page only shows it while the project loads; after that the project name replaces it (`ResearchDashboard.vue:69`). The app name should always be in the app header.
- **Privacy badge.** "100% Private | 0g CO₂ Transferred" in the processing status bar (`ProcessingStatus.vue:148`) no longer matches the hosted design. Remove it. A "where is this project stored" indicator may come back later (see the last criterion).
- **Settings button.** The project page header has a Settings button (`ResearchDashboard.vue:78–87`). Its icon is malformed (a circle with loose lines, not a cog). The window it opens (`AppSettings.vue`) only has "Auto-calibrate ETA" and a reset button. Remove the button and `AppSettings.vue`. Keep `useEtaCalibration` working with auto-calibrate on by default, so the time-remaining estimates in `ProcessingTimeStats` keep learning. The calibration data is per-stage timings in browser storage, with no personal data.
- **Comment.** `src/services/ai/transformersRuntime.ts:15` describes the app as an "air-gapped PWA".

## Parent Story

Hosted-first pivot (ADR 0001). Found 2026-11-18 while reviewing the UI.

## Blocked by

Nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] "Jobs-to-be-Done Research Assistant" no longer appears in `src/`.
- [ ] Both pages share one app header (e.g. an `AppHeader` component) that always shows "AirGap UX" as brand text linking to `/`. It is not an `<h1>`.
- [ ] Each page has exactly one `<h1>` naming the page: "Projects" on the project list (replacing today's `<h1>` AirGap UX + `<h2>` Projects), and the project name on the project page. Focus handling after navigation still targets the page heading.
- [ ] The privacy badge and its icon and styles are removed from `ProcessingStatus.vue`.
- [ ] The Settings button and `AppSettings.vue` are removed, and so is the `AppSettings` stub in `ResearchDashboard.spec.ts`. ETA calibration still records runs (auto-calibrate defaults to on), and existing `ProcessingStatus` / `ProcessingTimeStats` specs pass.
- [ ] The "air-gapped PWA" comment in `transformersRuntime.ts` is reworded.
- [ ] Specs cover the shared header (app name present on both pages, one `<h1>` each). `npm run code-quality` passes.
- [ ] `notes/task-list.md` has a note that a "where this project is stored" indicator may be needed once local storage returns.

## Suggested label

`ready-for-agent`
